name: Daily Brief
description: Turn overnight sources into a short morning newsletter.

metadata.prompt: Write a morning brief from sources ingested in the last 24 hours. Lead with the single most important signal. Keep total length under 600 words. Use short paragraphs and bullet clusters. End with a one-line watchlist.

name: Weekly Digest
description: Cluster the week's content into 5–7 thematic sections automatically.

metadata.prompt: Cluster this week's sources into 5–7 thematic sections. Each section needs a sharp headline, 2–3 annotated bullets, and a bridging sentence to the next theme.

name: Founder Letter
description: Rewrite raw updates into a personal, narrative-style email.

metadata.prompt: Transform raw founder updates into a personal letter. Open with a human moment, weave wins and setbacks into narrative, extract one lesson, and close with a sincere forward look.

name: Product Changelog
description: Convert shipped features into release-note-friendly newsletter copy.

metadata.prompt: Turn shipped work into release notes. Group by Shipped, Improved, Fixed. Each item: what changed, who benefits, and one example. Avoid internal jargon.

name: Learning Course
description: Turn one topic into a multi-issue educational series.

metadata.prompt: Design a progressive lesson for this module. State the objective, teach one core concept, show a worked example, assign a short exercise, and recap with check-for-understanding questions.

name: Research Roundup
description: Extract findings, caveats, and implications from papers.

metadata.prompt: Summarize research papers: state the finding plainly, note methodology limits, list caveats, explain practical implications, and link further reading.

name: Community Recap
description: Summarize Discord, forum, and discussion highlights.

metadata.prompt: Recap community discussions. Surface top threads, recurring questions, overall sentiment, and member shoutouts. Quote lightly and attribute.

name: Customer Insight
description: Turn support conversations into pattern-based takeaways.

metadata.prompt: Analyze support themes. Group by pattern, name friction points, list feature requests with frequency, and recommend product actions.

name: Sales Follow-Up
description: Turn call notes into a tailored recap email.

metadata.prompt: Draft a post-call recap. Mirror the prospect's goals, restate agreed value, list concrete next steps with owners, and attach relevant resources.

name: Market Pulse
description: Assemble competitor moves, trends, and notable signals.

metadata.prompt: Build a market pulse issue. Cover macro context, competitor moves with sources, emerging trends, weak signals worth watching, and a short outlook.

name: Podcast-to-Newsletter
description: Convert transcripts into readable editorial sections.

metadata.prompt: Convert a podcast transcript into editorial sections. Lead with a hook, timestamp key moments, pull 2–3 quotable lines, list actionable takeaways, and link the episode.

name: Video-to-Newsletter
description: Turn YouTube transcripts into lesson-driven summaries.

metadata.prompt: Turn a video transcript into a lesson. Overview the goal, break into numbered steps, include a mermaid diagram when helpful, add a practice prompt, link the video.

name: Event Recap
description: Turn conference notes into a 'what mattered' issue.

metadata.prompt: Write an event recap focused on what mattered. Headline the theme, summarize standout sessions, list announcements, note networking highlights, and collect resource links.

name: Case Study
description: Transform one success story into a full persuasive newsletter.

metadata.prompt: Expand a success story into a case study newsletter. Challenge → approach → quantified results → proof points → clear CTA.

name: Opinion Essay
description: Draft a strong point-of-view issue from a thesis statement.

metadata.prompt: Write a point-of-view essay from the given thesis. Build a logical argument, acknowledge a counterpoint fairly, cite evidence, and land a memorable conclusion.

name: Curated Links
description: Generate annotations for each link instead of generic summaries.

metadata.prompt: Curate links with editorial annotations—not generic summaries. For each link: why it matters, who should read it, and one sharp insight.

name: Internal Team Update
description: Format ops, blockers, and wins for staff emails.

metadata.prompt: Format an internal team update. Wins first, then in-progress work, blockers with owners, explicit asks, and team shoutouts.

name: Investor Update
description: Output metrics, narrative, risks, and asks in one structure.

metadata.prompt: Write an investor update: highlights, key metrics with deltas, narrative on progress, honest risks, and specific asks.

name: Hiring Newsletter
description: Package open roles, culture, and team momentum into one email.

metadata.prompt: Create a hiring newsletter. Why join now, open roles with requirements, culture signals, recent team wins, and a clear apply CTA.

name: Re-Engagement
description: Rewrite old content into a fresh issue for inactive readers.

metadata.prompt: Re-engage inactive readers. Open with what's new since they left, refresh the best prior content with updated context, and end with a low-friction CTA.
